modelspec.artifact.ContentHash.title: ContentHash
modelspec.artifact.ContentHash.description: A blake3 digest under explicit serialization and version rules (DESIGN.md § 7).

modelspec.data.DatasetSplit.title: DatasetSplit
modelspec.data.DatasetSplit.description: One split of a corpus, made from one file of the release, not by a fraction or a shuffle, so the held-out set is the one every published WikiText-103 number uses. Train is `wiki.train.raw` and HeldOut is `wiki.valid.raw`; `wiki.test.raw` is not read. `modelspec data prepare` copies the file byte for byte to `train.raw` or `heldout.raw` in its output directory. A split is identified by role, content_hash, document_count and byte_count (coordinator decision D19, 2026-10-24, `.engineering/waves/bert-1.md`).

content_hash.description: The blake3 hash of the split file's bytes, 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits (coordinator decision D19, 2026-10-24, `.engineering/waves/bert-1.md`).

document_count.description: The number of documents in the split. A document is one article of the release. It starts at a top-level heading line `= <title> =` (one `=` on each side, surrounding whitespace ignored, `= = <section> = =` is not one), and any non-blank text before the first heading is one document too (coordinator decision D19, 2026-10-24, `.engineering/waves/bert-1.md`).

byte_count.description: The length of the split file in bytes; the file is UTF-8 (coordinator decision D19, 2026-10-24, `.engineering/waves/bert-1.md`).

modelspec.data.SplitRole.title: SplitRole
modelspec.data.SplitRole.description: What a split is used for; MLM loss and accuracy are evaluated on the held-out split (epic:bert-from-scratch).
